title: 第13章 第二案：水泥藏尸（6）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李安国脸色阴沉如锅底。

反手就将念念推回到座位上。

他看他不是带了个实习生，是请了两祖宗！

两辆车一前一后驶到工地门口。

张秘书率先下车。

冯天笑脸相迎。

“张秘书，今天怎么有空过来，是王董有什么新指示？”

张秘书还没说话。

冯天就眼尖的看到李安国的车紧跟其后。

当即就想表现一下，直接指挥众人将车拦下。

“干嘛呢干嘛呢！施工重地，禁止入内。”

李安国降下车窗。

冯天看清他的脸，表情瞬间变了。

“又是你！你们有完没完？

上次我跟你说的已经很清楚了。

今天早上还派人过来。

以为派个女的我就不敢动手了？

我这建的可是高架！

耽误了工期，你们负的起责吗？”

张秘书：！！！

“冯经理！这位李警官是王董的客人。

王董交代了，不管他要干什么，我们都必须配合。”

冯天脸色变了又变。

在工地他是老大，可以呼风唤雨。

但一提起王董，他就没了招。

“我这也是为了工期，咱们公司可是签了合同，有违约金的。

如果不能按期交付，赔的可不少。

天天不是这个来就是那个来。

工人们全都忙着看热闹，哪有心思干活。

再说，我们这是工地，又忙又乱。

熟悉的还好，懂得怎么保护自己。

让这些门外汉进来，万一出点什么事，咱这项目还做不做了？”

张秘书脸色微变，声音蕴含警告。

“冯经理，工地的事我不懂。

但李警官是王董贵客，王董说了，不管他有什么要求，我们都必须配合。”

冯天沉默。

似乎是在心里权衡。

但好不容易有个名正言顺进入工地的机会。

李安国可不会放过。

没等冯天权衡出结果，他就径直走向安全备品存放区。

拿了一顶安全帽给念念带好。

又拿了三顶分别给张秘书、付泽宇和自己。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Anguo's face was as gloomy as the bottom of a pot.

With a backhand, he pushed Niannian back to his seat.

He saw that instead of bringing an intern, he invited two ancestors!

The two cars drove to the gate of the construction site one after the other.

Secretary Zhang got off the bus first.

Feng Tian greeted him with a smile.

"Secretary Zhang, why are you here free today? Does Mr. Wang have any new instructions?"

Secretary Zhang hasn't spoken yet.

Feng Tian saw with sharp eyes Li Anguo's car following closely behind him.

He immediately wanted to show off and directly directed everyone to stop the car.

"What are you doing? It's a heavy construction area and entry is prohibited."

Li Anguo lowered the window.

Feng Tian saw his face clearly, and his expression changed instantly.

"It's you again! Are you finished?

What I told you last time was very clear.

I even sent someone over this morning.

Do you think I won’t dare to take action if you send a girl?

What I built is an elevated one!

Can you take responsibility for delaying the construction period?"

Secretary Zhang:!!!

"Manager Feng! This police officer Li is Director Wang's guest.

Director Wang has made it clear that no matter what he wants to do, we must cooperate."

Feng Tian's expression changed again and again.

He is the boss at the construction site and can call the shots.

But when it came to Director Wang, he was at his wits end.

"I am doing this for the construction period. Our company has signed a contract and there are liquidated damages.

If you can't deliver on time, you'll pay a lot of money.

Every day it comes either this way or that way.

The workers were all busy watching the fun and had no time to think about working.

Besides, this is a construction site, so it’s busy and chaotic.

It's okay if you're familiar with it, you know how to protect yourself.

Let these laymen come in. If something happens, will we still be able to complete this project?"

Secretary Zhang's expression changed slightly, and his voice contained a warning.

"Manager Feng, I don't understand anything about the construction site.

But Officer Li is Wang Dong’s distinguished guest. Wang Dong has said that no matter what his request is, we must cooperate."

Feng Tian was silent.

It seems that he is weighing it in his mind.

But it was not easy to get a legitimate opportunity to enter the construction site.

Li Anguo will not let it go.

Before Feng Tian could weigh the results, he went straight to the safe spare parts storage area.

I got a safety helmet and put it on for Nian Nian.

He took three more caps and gave them to Secretary Zhang, Fu Zeyu and himself.
